verdict.rationale: The firm publishes Prarambh on its own pages: a named startup program with stated terms, including a 10-week cohort, a 12-stage programme, mentorship, and eligibility for registered businesses at least one year old. However, Prarambh is a legaltech incubator for building legal-technology products, not a legal-services package for founders. Its pages state no fee terms such as deferred fees, fixed-fee formation or discounts. Missing for 10: any published fee terms (deferred or fixed-fee) for startup legal work, a startup legal-services package open to non-legaltech founders, and independent corroboration.
